visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long black hair styled over one eye, wearing glasses, a black suit, white shirt, and black tie, stands in a bedroom. He sings energetically into a microphone. Behind him is a blue wall, a bed, a lamp, and an electronic keyboard. An inset video at the top shows another man in a purple suit gesturing dramatically in a formal hall. (2) The man continues singing, becoming more animated and tossing his jacket onto the bed. He gestures wildly with his hands, mimicking the man in the inset video. The lighting is warm and indoor. (3) The scene cuts to the man resting his head on the keyboard, looking exhausted. He sings with a melancholic expression. The inset video is absent. (4) He stands up, puts his jacket back on, and adjusts his tie. He returns to singing with high intensity, his hair flying as he moves. The inset video reappears. (5) The video ends with him singing the final chorus with extreme energy, jumping and gesturing before leaning over the microphone stand in a deep bow or slump.

The recording is clean with artificial reverb applied to the vocals. (2) The vocal delivery remains intense, with the singer occasionally shouting or using a strained, emotional tone to emphasize the lyrics. The piano maintains a steady 120 BPM tempo. Small rustling sounds are faintly audible as the performer moves. (3) A bridge section features a transition to a softer, more melancholic piano melody. The vocal drops in volume and becomes breathy, conveying a mood of exhaustion. (4) The music returns to the energetic main chorus with loud, projected singing. The spectral brightness increases as the singer reaches higher notes. The track is highly compressed for a social-media broadcast sound.
